lines.en: label day103:
: I think I’ll go to[school] today.
lines.zh: : 我想我今天还是去[school]吧。

lines.en: scene black
scene street_noon
I’m walking to[school], the same way I do pretty much every other day.
lines.zh: 我跟平时差不多，正走着去[school]的路。

lines.en: The only difference is that everyone I know seems to have vanished.
lines.zh: 唯一的不同是，我认识的人似乎全都消失了。

lines.en: How strange!
lines.zh: 真是奇怪！

lines.en: I’m sure they’ll all be back soon enough.
lines.zh: 我相信他们很快就会回来的。

lines.en: In fact, maybe they all went to[school] as well?
lines.zh: 事实上，说不定他们也全都去[school]了？

lines.en: I’m not sure why they’d do something like this on the weekend but-
lines.zh: 我不知道他们为什么会在周末干这种事，不过——

lines.en: Well, I guess I’m not really sure of anything anymore.
lines.zh: 算了，反正我现在对什么事都拿不准。

lines.en: scene street2_noon
I decide to take a detour and head over to a different section of the city.
lines.zh: 我决定绕个路，去城市的另一片区域看看。

lines.en: There are normally a lot more people around here, so I figured checking this place out would help me realize if {i}everyone{/i} was gone or just the people I knew.
lines.zh: 平时这一带人要多得多，所以我想，去那儿看看就能弄清楚到底是{i}所有人{/i}都消失了，还是只有我认识的人不在了。

lines.en: But, as it turns out-
lines.zh: 但结果——

lines.en: It really is everyone!
lines.zh: 真的是所有人都不见了！

lines.en: show amihappyyay
: {size=+25}HOW THE FUCK ARE YOU DOING???{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=+25}你他妈过得怎么样啊？？？{/size}

lines.en: : Morning, Ami. Glad to see you’re back.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Ami。很高兴看到你回来了。

lines.en: : You look as cute as ever.
lines.zh: : 你还是和平时一样可爱。

lines.en: : {s}It's so dark{/s} Heheh~ Did you miss me?
lines.zh: : {s}这儿好黑啊{/s}，嘿嘿~想我了吗？

lines.en: : More than you know! Your best friend gave me a handjob the other day and I really wish you were around to see it.
lines.zh: : 比你想的还要想！你最好的朋友前两天给我打了个飞机，我真希望你当时在场看着。

lines.en: : Maya did? LOL!
lines.zh: : Maya 干的？笑死我了！

lines.en: : As if I’d believe that!
lines.zh: : 我才不信呢！

lines.en: : No, I mean it. There are cum stains all over the sheets now.
lines.zh: : 我说真的。现在床单上全是精斑。

lines.en: : There are always cum stains all over your sheets. You have a masturbation problem, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你的床单上什么时候没有精斑啊。你有手淫上瘾的毛病，Sensei。

lines.en: : Hahaha, I really do~
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈，确实~

lines.en: scene citynoon
show amihappyyay
Ami and I continue our journey through Kumon-mi, walking into various stores along the way to see if anyone is willing to sell us a drink.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 继续在 Kumon-mi 里穿行，一路走进各家店铺，看看有没有人愿意卖给我们一杯喝的。

lines.en: Of course, no one is. But that’s mostly due to the fact that people don’t exist anymore. Hahah.
lines.zh: 当然没有。但这主要是因为人已经不存在了。哈哈。

lines.en: : So, what now?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来怎么办？

lines.en: : You were on your way to[school], weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你本来是准备去[school]的吧？

lines.en: : How come?
lines.zh: : 为什么呢？

lines.en: : Not sure. It just seemed like the right choice.
lines.zh: : 不知道。只是觉得这么做比较对。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I know what you mean. Sometimes, it feels like I don’t really have any options either.
lines.zh: : 好吧好吧。我懂你的意思。有时候我也觉得自己其实没什么选择。

lines.en: : Like in the beginning of Lessons in Love where you got to play the Breed Your Niece minigame! How crazy was that?!
lines.zh: : 就像《Lessons in Love》开头，你还能玩「繁殖你的侄女」那个小游戏！那玩意儿多离谱啊？！

lines.en: : That was a dream, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那是个梦吧？

lines.en: : But it felt so real! So real that I may have even gotten dream-pregnant!
lines.zh: : 可它感觉好真实啊！真实到我可能都做梦想怀孕了！

lines.en: : Dream-pregnant?
lines.zh: : 梦想怀孕？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s when you have dream-sex that makes a dream-baby. Like Maya.
lines.zh: : 对啊。就是做了春梦，然后有了个梦宝宝。比如 Maya。

lines.en: : But Maya is a normal [teenage]girl, isn't she?
lines.zh: : 可 Maya 是个普通的[teenage]女孩吧？

lines.en: : Oh, you’re right. I must be thinking about someone else.
lines.zh: : 哦，你说得对。我肯定是想到别人了。

lines.en: : Maybe...Yumi? Or...how about Futaba? Do either of those two seem dreamlike to you?
lines.zh: : 要不……Yumi？还是……Futaba 怎么样？你觉得她们两个看起来像梦里的人吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly.
lines.zh: : 不怎么像。

lines.en: : You kind of do, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你倒是挺像的。

lines.en: : Me? But I look so normal and correct.
lines.zh: : 我？可我明明看起来又正常又标准啊。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. Your body is bent into an incredibly strange shape and you have text all over you.
lines.zh: : 才不。你的身体扭曲成了一种极其古怪的形状，而且身上全是字。

lines.en: : Hey! I'm sensitive about that text!
lines.zh: : 喂！我对身上那些字很敏感的！

lines.en: : I'm sorry, Ami. What can I do to make it up to you?
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，Ami。我要怎么做才能补偿你呢？

lines.en: : You can let me lick the dried cum off of your bedsheets with my special tongue!
lines.zh: : 你可以让我用我这条特别的舌头，把你床单上干掉的精液舔干净！

lines.en: : Okay. Have fun.
lines.zh: : 好啊。玩得开心。

lines.en: : Yay!
Ami floats away to go lick cum and I am left standing in the middle of the road.
lines.zh: Ami 飘走去舔精液了，只剩我一个人站在马路中间。

lines.en: If this were a normal day, I would be run over by a car {s}like her parents{/s} but, thankfully, no one is able to drive on account of not existing.
lines.zh: 要是平常的日子，我早就{s}跟她父母一样{/s}被车撞死了，不过幸运的是，因为人不存在，也没谁能开车。

lines.en: scene black
scene street_noon
: Okay...finally back on track.
lines.zh: : 好了……总算回到正题了。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll be able to make it to[school] this time without being stopped?
lines.zh: : 这次也许我能顺利走到[school]，不会再被打断了？

lines.en: : Huh. I wonder what I should do about the whole ‘end of the year’ thing.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我在想「学年末」那件事该怎么办。

lines.en: : I still haven’t come up with a plan for how to convince the staff to let me continue teaching my class.
lines.zh: : 我还没想出办法说服校方让我继续教这个班。

lines.en: : I guess a lot of it rides on how well they do on their exams, but...
lines.zh: : 我想大部分得看她们考试成绩怎么样，不过……

lines.en: : I hope all of them suddenly vanishing doesn’t carry any sort of negative implication in that regard.
lines.zh: : 我希望她们集体消失这件事，不会在这方面有什么不好的暗示。

lines.en: : Did everyone just disappear because they didn’t do well on their tests?
lines.zh: : 大家突然消失，总不会是因为考试没考好吧？

lines.en: : I hope not. That would mean that I am a bad teacher. I am a very good teacher.
lines.zh: : 希望不是。那说明我是个糟糕的老师。我可是个非常好的老师。

lines.en: : It has to be something else.
lines.zh: : 肯定有别的原因。

lines.en: : Oh well.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: : I’ll find out when I get to[school].
lines.zh: : 等到了[school]我就会知道了。

lines.en: scene black
scene emptyclassroom
: Good morning, desks.
lines.zh: : 早上好啊，课桌们。

lines.en: : How are you all doing today?
lines.zh: : 今天过得怎么样？

lines.en: The desks do not respond because they are desks.
lines.zh: 课桌没有回应，因为它们是课桌。

lines.en: : You all have detention. See me after class.
lines.zh: : 你们全体留堂。下课后到我这儿来。

lines.en: Again, no response.
lines.zh: 依旧没有回应。

lines.en: I begin to pace around the classroom, looking for faint traces of life or goodbye notes or things that smell like the girls that I could jerk off to.
lines.zh: 我开始在教室里踱步，寻找一丝生命的痕迹、告别信，或者任何闻起来像那些女孩子的、能让我打飞机用的东西。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I find nothing.
lines.zh: 可惜，我什么也没找到。

lines.en: scene hall_night
: Woah. It's dark all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。天突然就黑了。

lines.en: : Is class really over already? How long was I in there?
lines.zh: : 已经放学了吗？我在里面待了多久？

lines.en: if day > 5:
: Oh, right. We don’t have class on weekends.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。周末不上课。

lines.en: : Silly me.
lines.zh: : 我真傻。

lines.en: else:
: Oh well. Guess there's no use in worrying about that now.
lines.zh: : 算了。现在担心也没用了。

lines.en: : Maybe time just decided to move differently today.
lines.zh: : 也许今天时间只是走得不太一样吧。

lines.en: : I wonder what I should do now, though?...
lines.zh: : 可我现在该干什么呢？……

lines.en: : Maybe Ami is done floating and licking and is able to cook me up a nice batch of snails?
lines.zh: : 也许 Ami 已经飘完、舔完了，能给我煮上一锅好吃的蜗牛？

lines.en: show hope
: HELLO AGAIN
lines.zh: : 又见面了

lines.en: : IT SEEMS THAT I AM IN {b}YOUR{/b} WORLD THIS TIME
lines.zh: : 看来这一次是我来到了{b}你的{/b}世界

lines.en: : Do I know you?...
lines.zh: : 我认识你吗？……

lines.en: A strange figure appears before me.
lines.zh: 一个奇怪的身影出现在我面前。

lines.en: I feel like I’ve seen it somewhere else, but I can’t quite put my finger on {i}where{/i}...
lines.zh: 我觉得自己好像在别的地方见过它，可就是想不起来是在{i}哪儿{/i}……

lines.en: : MAYBE
lines.zh: : 也许吧

lines.en: : You’re not...God, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是……上帝，对吧？

lines.en: : WOULD YOU LIKE TO FIND OUT????
lines.zh: : 你想知道吗？？？？

lines.en: : No, but...
lines.zh: : 不想，不过……

lines.en: : Can you maybe tell me where everyone went? You seem like the kind of large, white thing that would know.
lines.zh: : 你能不能告诉我大家都去哪儿了？你看起来像是那种又大又白、什么都知道的东西。

lines.en: : EVERYONE???
: My students, the other people in Kumon-mi...Everyone is gone.
lines.zh: : 我的学生们，Kumon-mi 里的其他人……所有人都不见了。

lines.en: : ARE THEY???
: You don’t know?
lines.zh: : 你不知道？

lines.en: : I KNOW EVERYTHING
lines.zh: : 我什么都知道

lines.en: : So...are you going to tell me? Or are you just going to be a big ole' jerk about this?
lines.zh: : 那……你打算告诉我吗？还是就打算一直这么讨人厌地卖关子？

lines.en: : I WILL NOT TELL YOU WHAT YOU WISH TO KNOW
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉你你想知道的事

lines.en: : YOU SEEK AN ANSWER YOU MUST FIND YOURSELF
lines.zh: : 你寻求的答案，必须由你自己去找到

lines.en: : BUT THERE IS SOMETHING ELSE I CAN TELL YOU
lines.zh: : 但还有一件事我可以告诉你

lines.en: : YOU DO NOT HAVE TO UNCOVER THE ANSWER ALONE
lines.zh: : 你不必独自揭开这个答案

lines.en: : THERE IS SOMEONE WHO CAN HELP YOU
lines.zh: : 有一个人能帮你

lines.en: : There is? Who?
lines.zh: : 有吗？谁？

lines.en: : THE GIRL WITH THE BELL
lines.zh: : 带着铃铛的女孩

lines.en: The girl with the bell?...
lines.zh: 带着铃铛的女孩？……

lines.en: : Do you mean Maya?
lines.zh: : 你是说 Maya 吗？

lines.en: : She's still here?
lines.zh: : 她还在这儿吗？

lines.en: : SOMEONE IS HERE
lines.zh: : 有人在这里

lines.en: : I DO NOT KNOW HER NAME
lines.zh: : 我不知道她的名字

lines.en: : Well, where has she been? I haven't seen her anywhere.
lines.zh: : 那她一直都在哪儿？我到处都没看见她。

lines.en: : SHE HAS BEEN RIGHT NEXT TO YOU THIS WHOLE TIME
lines.zh: : 她一直就在你身边

lines.en: : SHE HAS SEEN YOU
lines.zh: : 她看见你了

lines.en: : THE ANSWER YOU SEEK IS HERE
lines.zh: : 你要找的答案就在这里

lines.en: : FOLLOW YOUR HEART!!! TO THE TOP OF THE UNIVERSE!!!
lines.zh: : 追随你的心！！！直到宇宙的顶点！！！

lines.en: : LOOK UP!!!
lines.zh: : 抬头看！！！

lines.en: I tilt my neck up-
lines.zh: 我抬起头——

lines.en: scene reset1
And the same shooting pain I experienced yesterday assaults my senses once again.
lines.zh: 昨天经历过的那阵刺痛，再次袭击了我的感官。

lines.en: My brain goes back to being strangled as every sound in the universe combines into one.
lines.zh: 宇宙里所有的声音融为一体，我的大脑又像被勒住了一样。

lines.en: The noise crawls into my ears and sets fire to the world that I believe in- the world that I have come to love.
lines.zh: 噪声爬进我的耳朵，把我所相信的、我所爱上的这个世界付之一炬——

lines.en: And in that same world, right in front of me, is a girl who seems to know something.
lines.zh: 而就在同一个世界里，就在我面前，站着一个似乎知道些什么的女孩。

lines.en: But what does she know?
lines.zh: 可她知道些什么呢？

lines.en: And will she tell a poor soul like me?
lines.zh: 她又会告诉像我这样可怜的人吗？

lines.en: : You made it.
lines.zh: : 你来了。

lines.en: : I was beginning to think you wouldn’t show up.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你不会出现了。

lines.en: scene reset2
Maya turns around and looks directly into my eyes, seemingly unfazed by the galaxies connecting above our heads.
lines.zh: Maya 转过身，直视我的眼睛，似乎对我们头顶上连接着的星系无动于衷。

lines.en: It’s a wonderful array of colors- one that I’d be much happier to see if I could find the right level of oxygen up here.
lines.zh: 那是一片绚烂的色彩——要是我在上面能找到合适浓度的氧气，我会更乐意欣赏它的。

lines.en: The higher up you go, the harder it is to breathe.
lines.zh: 越往高处走，呼吸就越困难。

lines.en: But that’s something you know, I’m sure.
lines.zh: 不过这种事你肯定知道，我敢肯定。

lines.en: Thankfully, we’ve not yet reached the top of everything.
lines.zh: 所幸，我们还没有抵达一切的顶点。

lines.en: And I can still breathe just a little.
lines.zh: 我还能勉强喘上几口气。

lines.en: But you and I can not breathe together.
lines.zh: 可你和我，却没法一起呼吸。

lines.en: So what is even the point?
lines.zh: 那这一切又有什么意义呢？

lines.en: : How do you feel?
lines.zh: : 你感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Confused.
lines.zh: : 很困惑。

lines.en: scene reset3
: That’s understandable. Frankly, it would be worrying if you {i}weren't{/i} confused.
lines.zh: : 这很正常。说实话，你要是{i}不{/i}困惑才让人担心。

lines.en: : Do you know what’s going on here?
lines.zh: : 你知道这里发生了什么吗？

lines.en: : More than you, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少比你多知道一点。

lines.en: : Can you walk? Do you need help?
lines.zh: : 你能走吗？需要我扶你吗？

lines.en: : No, I-
lines.zh: : 不用，我——

lines.en: I try to move my legs, but they seem much heavier than normal.
lines.zh: 我试着动腿，可它们比平时重得多。

lines.en: After a few attempts, I’m able to lift them off the ground and manage to step closer to her.
lines.zh: 试了几次之后，我总算能把腿从地上抬起来，勉强朝她走近了几步。

lines.en: scene reset4
: Is there anything you’d like to ask me?
lines.zh: : 你有什么想问我的吗？

lines.en: : A lot, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实挺多的。

lines.en: : Then ask...
lines.zh: : 那就问吧……

lines.en: : And I will answer to the best of my ability.
lines.zh: : 我会尽我所能回答。

Where are we?
lines.zh: 我们在哪儿？

lines.en: : Where are we right now?...
lines.zh: : 我们现在是在哪儿？……

lines.en: : We’re in Kumon-mi. The same place you were reborn [totaldays] days ago.
lines.zh: : 我们在 Kumon-mi。就是你 [totaldays] 天前重生的那个地方。

lines.en: : Kumon-mi didn’t always look like this, though.
lines.zh: : 可 Kumon-mi 以前不是这个样子的。

lines.en: : It didn’t?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : No...Or...at least I don’t think it did.
lines.zh: : 不是……或者说……至少我觉得不应该是。

lines.en: : But you have no way of knowing for sure, correct?
lines.zh: : 但你自己也没有办法确定，对吧？

lines.en: : I’ve told you before-
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过的——

lines.en: : We all see things a little differently, but our sights are the same once you strip away whatever coat of paint you applied along the way.
lines.zh: : 我们每个人看到的东西都会有些不同，但只要把你沿途涂上的那层漆刮掉，我们所见的其实是同一个东西。

lines.en: : What appears to the naked eye on the surface may differ from person to person, but what those visions {i}are{/i} remains unchanged.
lines.zh: : 肉眼所见的表面可能因人而异，但这些景象的{i}本质{/i}始终不变。

lines.en: : Your Kumon-mi is different from mine. And mine is different from Ami's. But they’re still visions of the same Kumon-mi no matter whose eyes you're looking at them with.
lines.zh: : 你的 Kumon-mi 和我的不一样，我的也和 Ami 的不一样。可无论你用谁的眼睛去看，它们依旧是同一个 Kumon-mi 的景象。

lines.en: : Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 你明白吗？

lines.en: : Not even a little.
lines.zh: : 一点都不明白。

lines.en: scene reset5
: I figured as much.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : I guess I can’t really hold it against you this time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这一次，我也不太好怪你。

lines.en: : But you’ll understand eventually.
lines.zh: : 但你迟早会明白的。

lines.en: scene reset6

lines.zh: : 又或者……

lines.en: : At least I hope you will.
lines.zh: : 至少我希望你会。

lines.zh: : 其他人都去哪儿了？为什么今天我只碰到了你？

lines.en: scene reset4
: Do you think that's something I'm aware of?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这种事我会知道吗？

lines.en: : I have no idea what to think.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该想什么。

lines.en: : Well, I'm sorry to disappoint you...but I don’t know where they went.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很遗憾让你失望了……但我不知道他们去哪儿了。

lines.en: : It's the same every time this happens.
lines.zh: : 每次发生这种事都一样。

lines.en: : Every time? This has happened before?
lines.zh: : 每次？以前也发生过？

: Far too often, if you ask me.
lines.zh: : 依我看，发生过太多次了。

lines.en: : I’m getting kind of sick of it, to be honest. But at this point, it's inevitable.
lines.zh: : 说实话我都有点烦了。但事到如今，这也是不可避免的。

lines.en: : Well...is there anything we can do to bring them back?
lines.zh: : 那……我们有什么办法能把他们带回来吗？

lines.en: scene reset4
: Do you care about them that much?
lines.zh: : 你有那么在乎他们吗？

lines.en: : Isn’t there something {i}more{/i} important to you?
lines.zh: : 难道没有对你来说{i}更{/i}重要的东西吗？

lines.en: : I...don’t think so?...
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得有？……

lines.en: : What is there that would be more important than bringing everyone back?
lines.zh: : 还有什么能比把大家带回来更重要？

lines.en: scene reset7
: You really don’t know?
lines.zh: : 你真的不知道吗？

lines.en: : No...I don’t know {i}anything...{/i}and I think I’ve made that pretty apparent.
lines.zh: : 不知道……我{i}什么{/i}都不知道……我想这一点我已经表现得很明显了。

lines.en: scene reset8
: You’ll know eventually.
lines.zh: : 你迟早会知道的。

lines.en: : And if you don't, you don't.
lines.zh: : 要是不知道，那也就不知道了。

lines.en: : You can't miss something at all if you don't know that you're supposed to miss it.
lines.zh: : 如果你根本不知道自己该去想念什么，那你就一点都不会想念。

lines.en: : So...if you wind up remembering what's more important to you than everything else-
lines.zh: : 所以……要是有一天你想起了什么对你来说比一切都重要的东西——

lines.en: : Maybe bring this up again the next time we meet here, okay?
lines.zh: : 下次我们在这里见面时，也许可以再提一次，好吗？

Who are you?
lines.zh: 你是谁？

lines.en: : Who {i}are{/i} you exactly?...
lines.zh: : 你到底{i}是{/i}谁？……

lines.en: scene reset8
: Maya Makinami. A normal teenage girl.
lines.zh: : Maya Makinami。一个普通的青春期少女。

lines.en: : That was an easy question.
lines.zh: : 这个问题很简单。

lines.en: : I know your name...what I don’t understand is why you seem so calm right now.
lines.zh: : 我知道你的名字……我不明白的是，你为什么现在看起来这么冷静。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like panicking would help, given the circumstances.
lines.zh: : 嗯，在这种情况下，慌也没用吧。

lines.en: : The first few times, I was just as terrified as you.
lines.zh: : 最开始那几次，我和你一样害怕。

lines.en: : How many times have you been through this?
lines.zh: : 你经历过多少次了？

lines.en: : I’ve stopped counting.
lines.zh: : 我已经不数了。

lines.en: : There’s no point anymore.
lines.zh: : 没有意义了。

lines.en: : It only makes things harder.
lines.zh: : 只会让事情更难熬。

lines.en: : You're not, like...{i}God...{/i}are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会是……{i}上帝{/i}之类的吧？

lines.en: : Do you think you've been sucked into some sort of manga or something?
lines.zh: : 你以为自己被吸进什么漫画里了吗？

lines.en: : Of course I’m not god.
lines.zh: : 我当然不是上帝。

lines.en: : I’m just a very unlucky girl.
lines.zh: : 我只是个运气特别差的女孩。

lines.en: : Nothing more...
lines.zh: : 仅此而已……

lines.en: : Nothing less.
lines.zh: : 不多不少。

lines.en: $ resetq3 = True
jump resetquestions
How much of this is real?
lines.zh: 这有多少是真的？

lines.en: : Is any of this real? Or is this just...a dream or something?
lines.zh: : 这些是真的吗？还是说……这只是个梦之类的？

lines.en: scene reset4
: Nothing is real. You already know that.
lines.zh: : 没有什么是真的。你早就知道了。

lines.en: : You’ve been told time and time again.
lines.zh: : 已经有人一而再再而三地告诉过你了。

lines.en: : Why are you so surprised to be somewhere like this despite all of that?
lines.zh: : 尽管如此，你到了这种地方为什么还这么惊讶？

lines.en: : I think anyone would be surprised if they walked onto a[school] roof and were met with...whatever is going on in the sky right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得任何人走到[school]天台上，看到……天上现在那副景象，都会惊讶的吧。

lines.en: : A fair point.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : But still, I don’t think it’s as unexpected as you’re making it out to be.
lines.zh: : 但我还是觉得，这并不像你说的那么出乎意料。

lines.en: : You’ve had your hand held through everything.
lines.zh: : 一路走来，都有人牵着你的手。

lines.en: : I wonder who it is that's been holding it?
lines.zh: : 我倒是想知道，一直牵着它的那个人是谁？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about...
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么……

lines.en: scene reset5
: Well, whatever. I guess I’ll just remind you {i}again{/i}.
lines.zh: : 算了，无所谓。我想我还是{i}再{/i}提醒你一次吧。

lines.en: scene reset4
: Nothing is real. Nothing will ever be real.
lines.zh: : 没有什么是真的。什么都不会是真的。

lines.en: scene reset6
: At least that’s what I keep telling myself.
lines.zh: : 至少我是这么一直告诉自己的。

lines.en: $ resetq4 = True
jump resetquestions
What happens next?
lines.zh: 接下来会怎样？

lines.en: : So...what happens next then?
lines.zh: : 那么……接下来会怎样？

label restofthereset:
scene reset8
: I'm glad you asked.
lines.zh: : 很高兴你问这个。

lines.en: : What comes next is my favorite part.
lines.zh: : 接下来是我最喜欢的部分。

lines.en: : The end of the world.
lines.zh: : 世界的终结。

lines.en: : Isn’t it beautiful?
lines.zh: : 很美吧？

lines.en: : Just look at the sky. It’s unlike anything else you've ever seen...isn't it?
lines.zh: : 看看这片天空。它和你见过的任何东西都不一样……不是吗？

lines.en: It’s true...
lines.zh: 她说得没错……

lines.en: Despite the incredibly thin air and how hard it’s become to move my limbs, it truly is beautiful up here.
lines.zh: 尽管空气稀薄得要命，四肢也越来越难动弹，但这里的景色真的很美。

lines.en: Part of me wishes I could stay and observe this sky forever.
lines.zh: 我有一部分希望自己能永远留在这里，看着这片天空。

lines.en: But something deep inside of me tells me that I don’t have much longer at all.
lines.zh: 可内心深处有什么在告诉我，我剩下的时间已经不多了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to be scared of what happens next. Everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 你不必害怕接下来发生的事。一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : If this place were dangerous, don’t you think I’d stop coming?
lines.zh: : 如果这地方危险，你觉得我还会一直来吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know why you do {i}anything{/i}, to be completely honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我真不知道你做{i}任何事{/i}的理由是什么。

lines.en: : Everything about you seems like some big secret.
lines.zh: : 你的一切都像是个巨大的秘密。

lines.en: : Maybe everything about me {i}is{/i} some big secret?
lines.zh: : 也许我的一切{i}就是{/i}个巨大的秘密呢？

lines.en: : Maybe you're a little closer to the truth than you think?
lines.zh: : 也许你比你以为的更接近真相？

lines.en: scene reset9
: And maybe if you keep annoying me about opening up to you, you’ll eventually find that out.
lines.zh: : 也许你要是继续缠着我让我对你敞开心扉，总有一天会发现的。

lines.en: : Who knows?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。

lines.en: : You make it sound like we’re still going to have time to get to know each other after this.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，好像这之后我们还有时间互相了解似的。

lines.en: scene reset8
: Do you think we won’t?
lines.zh: : 你觉得没有吗？

lines.en: : Well...not if this is the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果这就是世界末日的话，应该没有吧。

lines.en: : Not if everyone is already gone.
lines.zh: : 如果大家都已经不在了。

lines.en: : That is correct.
lines.zh: : 说得对。

lines.en: : This {i}is{/i} the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 这{i}就是{/i}世界末日。

lines.en: : And everyone is most certainly already gone.
lines.zh: : 而且大家肯定都已经不在了。

lines.en: : But who says they're never coming back?
lines.zh: : 可谁说他们永远不会回来了？

lines.en: : What?...
: If {i}this{/i} is the end of the world...
lines.zh: : 如果{i}这{/i}是世界末日的话……

lines.en: : Then all we need to do is reset it.
lines.zh: : 那我们只需要把它重置就行了。

lines.en: : Again, {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，{i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: : We're going to reset the world.
lines.zh: : 我们要重置这个世界。

lines.en: : Well...{i}I'm{/i} going to reset the world.
lines.zh: : 好吧……{i}是我{/i}要重置这个世界。

lines.en: : You're going to watch.
lines.zh: : 你只要在旁边看着。

lines.en: : Is that something you can do?
lines.zh: : 这种事你做得到吗？

lines.en: : {i}How?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怎么做？{/i}

lines.en: scene reset9
: This is our world. We can do whatever we want in it.
lines.zh: : 这是我们的世界。我们想在这里做什么都行。

lines.en: : And right now, what we want is for it to be reset...Correct?
lines.zh: : 而现在，我们想要的就是让它重置……对吧？

lines.en: scene reset10
: You didn’t really think the[school] year was just going to carry on forever, did you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会真以为[school]这一年能一直持续下去吧？

lines.en: : Well, no...In fact, I’ve been kind of worried about how quickly everything was coming to an end lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不……事实上，我最近还一直在担心一切结束得太快了。

lines.en: scene reset5
: Yeah, I bet. That harem of yours has just started to take off, hasn’t it?...
lines.zh: : 是吧，我猜也是。你那个后宫才刚有点起色，不是吗？……

lines.en: : That’s really not what I was talking about...
lines.zh: : 我说的真不是这个……

lines.en: scene reset11
: {i}Hah{/i}...Well, whatever the case...
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}算了，不管怎么样……

lines.en: : I wouldn't worry too much about {i}completely{/i} starting over.
lines.zh: : 我劝你别太担心要{i}完全{/i}从头再来。

lines.en: : If all goes according to plan, your progress won't reset at all.
lines.zh: : 如果一切按计划进行，你的进度根本不会重置。

lines.en: My progress?...
lines.zh: 我的进度？……

lines.en: What does she mean by that?
lines.zh: 她这么说是什么意思？

lines.en: : Uh...Well, what do we have to do exactly?
lines.zh: : 呃……那我们具体要做什么？

lines.en: scene reset4
: Like I've said...{i}You{/i} don’t have to do anything. You can just stand there and...wait, I guess.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的……{i}你{/i}什么都不用做。你就站在那儿……等着，大概吧。

lines.en: : Soon, everything will go black...
lines.zh: : 很快，一切都会变黑……

lines.en: : And then you’ll wake up in a happier place.
lines.zh: : 然后你会在一个更幸福的地方醒来。

lines.en: : It might not be clear to you at first, but you'll figure it out soon enough.
lines.zh: : 一开始你也许不太明白，但你很快就会想通的。

lines.en: : And what about everyone else?
lines.zh: : 那其他人呢？

lines.en: : They'll come back as well?
lines.zh: : 他们也会回来吗？

lines.en: scene reset6
: It'll be like nothing ever changed.
lines.zh: : 会像什么都没发生过一样。

lines.en: : Again, {i}if all goes according to plan.{/i}
lines.zh: : 再说一次，{i}如果一切按计划进行的话。{/i}

lines.en: : Sometimes, plans fail and everything snaps.
lines.zh: : 有时候计划会失败，一切就会崩断。

lines.en: : But everyone, including myself, should be the same exact way they were when you last saw them.
lines.zh: : 但包括我在内的所有人，都应该和你上次见到时一模一样。

lines.en: scene reset4
: So, fortunately for you, you won’t have to worry about grooming anyone all over again.
lines.zh: : 所以，对你来说是好事，你不用再从头把谁重新调教一遍了。

lines.en: : Rejoice, Sensei. Your harem of misguided teenagers will emerge from the end of the world unscathed. What a wonderful day this is.
lines.zh: : 欢呼吧，Sensei。你那后宫里误入歧途的少女们会毫发无伤地从世界末日里走出来。今天是多么美妙的一天啊。

lines.en: : I’m surprised that you’re still making me out to be such a creep even at the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 真没想到，哪怕到了世界末日，你还是要把我说成这种变态。

lines.en: : Trust me, I’m not doing this because I want to.
lines.zh: : 相信我，我也不是因为想这么做才这么做的。

lines.en: : Then...why are you doing it?
lines.zh: : 那……你为什么要做？

lines.en: : {i}How{/i} are you doing it?
lines.zh: : 你是{i}怎么{/i}做到的？

lines.en: scene reset12
Instead of answering the question, Maya closes her eyes and begins to breathe deeply.
lines.zh: Maya 没有回答这个问题，而是闭上眼睛，开始深呼吸。

lines.en: I watch the way her chest moves as she inhales and exhales. It’s almost hypnotizing in a way.
lines.zh: 我看着她的胸膛随着呼吸起伏。某种意义上，这简直像催眠一样。

lines.en: : Please stop staring at my chest.
lines.zh: : 别盯着我的胸看。

lines.en: : How did you even know that? Your eyes are closed.
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道的？你眼睛都闭着。

lines.en: : I know everything about you, whether you like it or not.
lines.zh: : 不管你愿不愿意，关于你我什么都知道。

lines.en: : Now, please close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 现在，请闭上眼睛。

lines.en: : We're...doing this right now? This is it?
lines.zh: : 我们……现在就要做了吗？就是现在？

lines.en: : That's correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : It’s time to return things to how they should be.
lines.zh: : 是时候让一切回到它该有的样子了。

lines.en: : Or, at least...
lines.zh: : 或者，至少……

lines.en: : How they should be {i}for now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}暂时{/i}回到它该有的样子。

lines.en: scene black
I do as Maya says and close my eyes.
lines.zh: 我照 Maya 说的闭上眼睛。

lines.en: Within a matter of seconds, I feel her arms wrap around my waist.
lines.zh: 不过几秒钟，我就感觉到她的双臂环住了我的腰。

lines.en: Her face presses against my chest.
lines.zh: 她的脸贴在我的胸口。

lines.en: : I swear I’m only doing this because it won’t work if I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，我只是因为不做就不行才这么做的。

lines.en: : That’s something a tsundere would say.
lines.zh: : 这话傲娇才会说。

lines.en: : I already told you, the tsundere role is filled.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，傲娇那个角色已经有人演了。

lines.en: : Whatever. Just do what you need to do.
lines.zh: : 随便吧。你该干什么就干什么。

lines.en: : I would love to, but you keep talking.
lines.zh: : 我也想啊，可你一直在说话。

lines.en: : I’ll stop then.
lines.zh: : 那我不说了。

lines.en: : Fantastic. Then stop.
lines.zh: : 很好。那就别说了。

lines.en: : Stopping now.
lines.zh: : 正在闭嘴。

lines.en: : It doesn't sound like you're stopping.
lines.zh: : 听起来不像在闭嘴。

lines.en: : I'm stopping, I swear.
lines.zh: : 我在闭嘴了，我发誓。

lines.en: : Is this really happening?
lines.zh: : 这真的正在发生吗？

lines.en: : No more words.
lines.zh: : 不再说话了。

lines.en: : You’re the absolute worst human being alive.
lines.zh: : 你是全世界最烂的人。

lines.en: : You're only saying that because the only other human being alive right now is you.
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是因为现在全世界还活着的人就剩你了。

lines.en: : Silence...seriously.
lines.zh: : 安静……说真的。

lines.en: I stop teasing Maya and actually {i}do{/i} stop talking this time.
lines.zh: 我不再逗 Maya，这次{i}真的{/i}闭上了嘴。

lines.en: Her arms never leave my waist.
lines.zh: 她的手臂始终没有离开我的腰。

lines.en: I guess the two of us need to be touching in order for the ‘resetting’ process to work or something?
lines.zh: 我猜，「重置」的过程大概需要我们两个有身体接触才行？

lines.en: But even if that’s the case, isn’t this hug a little excessive?
lines.zh: 可就算是这样，这个拥抱是不是也有点太超过了？

lines.en: Wouldn’t just holding my hand be enough to-
lines.zh: 光是牵着我的手难道不够吗——

: About time! Do you have any idea how much trouble you'd get into if the principal showed up and caught you sleeping right now?
lines.zh: : 总算醒了！你知道要是校长这时候走进来，看见你在这儿睡觉，你会有多大的麻烦吗？

lines.en: : Class ended ten minutes ago. It's time to get up.
lines.zh: : 下课已经十分钟了。该起床了。

lines.en: : What? What class?
lines.zh: : 什么？什么课？

lines.en: : Where am I?
lines.zh: : 我这是在哪儿？

lines.en: : And...what did you call me just now?
lines.zh: : 还有……你刚才叫我什么来着？

lines.en: scene timetogrow2
: The...same thing I always call you? Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不就是……我一直以来对你的称呼吗？Sensei。

lines.en: : What's going on? Did you have a bad dream or something?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？做噩梦了吗？

lines.en: : I guess so...
lines.zh: : 大概是吧……

lines.en: : Do you want me to call the nurse or something? You seem a little flushed.
lines.zh: : 要我叫护士来吗？你看起来脸色有点红。

lines.en: scene timetogrow3
: Come a little closer so I can touch your forehead and find out.
lines.zh: : 再靠近一点，我好摸摸你的额头看看。

lines.en: : I'm fine...I think I just need a few minutes to collect myself or something.
lines.zh: : 我没事……我想我只是需要几分钟让自己缓一缓什么的。

lines.en: Excuse me for asking this so abruptly, but-
lines.zh: 抱歉这么突兀地问一句，不过——

lines.en: What the fuck is going on right now?
lines.zh: 现在到底他妈的是什么情况？

lines.en: Who is this girl? Or, better question, who am {i}I?{/i}
lines.zh: 这个女孩是谁？或者更好的问法是，{i}我{/i}是谁？

lines.en: Why can't I remember anything?...
lines.zh: 为什么我什么都想不起来？……

lines.en: This classroom seems vaguely familiar, but...
lines.zh: 这间教室看着有点眼熟，可是……

lines.en: But it's like each time I try to piece things together, I just circle back around and give up before I'm able to get anywhere.
lines.zh: 可每次我试着把事情拼凑起来，都只是原地打转，还没理出个头绪就先放弃了。

lines.en: This girl should probably know something, right?
lines.zh: 这个女孩应该知道点什么吧？

lines.en: But...if she's my student, she'll probably only know things that a {i}student{/i} would know. She'll have no idea who I am or...where I even live or-
lines.zh: 可是……如果她是我的学生，那她大概只知道一个{i}学生{/i}会知道的东西。她不会知道我是谁，也不会知道我住哪儿，或者——

lines.en: Wait, where am I supposed to go after I leave here when I still have absolutely no clue where I am?
lines.zh: 等等，我连自己在哪儿都完全没概念，离开这儿之后我该去哪儿？

lines.en: scene timetogrow4
: Um...are you sure you're okay? You're looking a little...panicky.
lines.zh: : 呃……你确定你没事吗？你看起来有点……慌。

lines.en: : I'm just...tired, I think.
lines.zh: : 我只是……累了，大概。

lines.en: : Still? Even after sleeping through the entire last period?
lines.zh: : 还累？你都睡过整整上一节课了。

lines.en: : Yeah, sorry. Long night, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。大概昨晚没睡好吧。

lines.en: scene timetogrow5
: Long night? But we were together the whole time.
lines.zh: : 昨晚？可我们一直都在一起啊。

lines.en: : I'm sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: Am I...dating a teenager?
lines.zh: 我……在和一个未成年少女交往？

lines.en: scene timetogrow6
: Okay, seriously. What's going on with you? You're acting like you don't even recognize your own niece.
lines.zh: : 好了，说真的。你到底怎么了？你表现得好像连自己的侄女都不认识了。

lines.en: Oh. So that's how it is.
lines.zh: 哦。原来是这么回事。

lines.en: Well, that is significantly less exciting. But at least I should be able to leverage that role to...try and make sense of what's going on here.
lines.zh: 好吧，这可就没那么刺激了。但至少我应该能利用这层关系……试着弄清楚这里到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: At the very least, if we're related, she'll probably know where I live.
lines.zh: 最起码，如果我们是亲戚，她大概知道我住哪儿。

lines.en: : Of course I recognize you. I'm just feeling a little out of it right now.
lines.zh: : 我当然认得你。我只是现在有点恍惚。

lines.en: scene timetogrow2
: Well, do you think going home might help? Because it doesn't seem like sticking around school is helping you at all right now.
lines.zh: : 那你觉得回家会不会好一点？因为看起来继续待在学校对你一点帮助都没有。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...do you think you might be able to come with me? I could probably use the help since I'm still...you know, regaining my footing and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过……你能不能陪我一起？我可能需要帮忙，毕竟我还在……你知道的，重新站稳脚跟之类的。

lines.en: : Why would I not come with you? We literally live together.
lines.zh: : 我为什么不能陪你？我们本来就住在一起啊。

lines.en: : Oh. Right. I forgot.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。我忘了。

lines.en: Well, at least my first five minutes in what I'm assuming is some sort of...alternate reality or something have been filled almost entirely with convenient coincidences.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少在我猜测的某种……平行世界还是什么的里，最初这五分钟几乎全是被各种方便的巧合填满的。

lines.en: That has to be what this is, right? Some sort of...reincarnation type thing?
lines.zh: 这肯定就是这么回事吧？某种……转生之类的？

lines.en: Wait, doesn't this mean that I must have died, though?
lines.zh: 等等，那不就意味着我一定已经死了吗？

lines.en: Just what the hell is happening to me all of a sudden?
lines.zh: 到底他妈的发生了什么？

lines.en: scene timetogrow7
: How can you just {i}forget{/i} that we've been living together for years?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能{i}忘了{/i}我们已经一起住了好几年？

lines.en: : What's next? Are you going to tell me you've forgotten my name?
lines.zh: : 接下来呢？你该不会要说你连我的名字都忘了吧？

lines.en: scene timetogrow8
: Oh my God! You {i}have{/i} forgotten my name, haven't you?!
lines.zh: : 天哪！你{i}真的{/i}把我的名字忘了，是不是？！

lines.en: : It's Ami, Sensei! {i}Ami!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我叫 Ami，Sensei！{i}Ami{/i}！

lines.en: : Sorry. It's nothing personal...probably.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不是针对你……大概。

lines.en: : Probably?!
lines.zh: : 大概？！

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I'm having a hard time remembering literally anything right now. So...I'll probably be leaning on you for help for a little while.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我现在几乎什么都想不起来。所以……接下来一段时间我可能得多靠你帮忙了。

lines.en: scene timetogrow9
: I mean...helping you is pretty much all I do in the first place, so I'm happy to do whatever you need me to.
lines.zh: : 嗯……反正我本来干的事基本就是在帮你，所以你需要我做什么我都乐意。

lines.en: : But if your memories are really that jumbled, shouldn't we take you to a doctor or something?
lines.zh: : 但如果你的记忆真的乱成那样，我们是不是该带你去看看医生？

lines.en: : You're old, but I didn't realize you were old enough to start dealing with that dementia thingy.
lines.zh: : 你是老了，但我没想到你已经老到要开始对付那种老年痴呆了。

lines.en: : I'm not {i}that{/i} old, am I?
lines.zh: : 我有{i}那么{/i}老吗？

lines.en: This body feels mostly healthy and well put together, so I can't imagine I'm any older than my 30's.
lines.zh: 这具身体感觉基本健康，也没什么毛病，所以我想我应该不超过三十几岁。

lines.en: : I guess not. You're actually one of the youngest teachers we have, I think.
lines.zh: : 应该没有。你其实是我们这儿最年轻的老师之一吧，我觉得。

lines.en: : But if there's something wrong with your brain, we should act now. Because if anything bad ever happened to you, I'd probably just die too.
lines.zh: : 但要是你脑子真出了问题，我们得现在就行动。因为要是你出了什么事，我大概也活不下去了。

lines.en: : That seems...excessive.
lines.zh: : 这听起来……有点夸张了。

lines.en: scene timetogrow10
: Well, if your memories really are gone, you'll be finding out very soon that that's just the type of girl I am!
lines.zh: : 哼，要是你的记忆真的没了，你很快就会发现，我就是这种女孩子！

lines.en: scene timetogrow11
: Or you're just lying about all of this because you hate me and want to play a weird prank on me, but I'll play along either way!
lines.zh: : 或者你只是在撒谎，因为你讨厌我，想用奇怪的恶作剧耍我，不过不管怎样我都会陪你演下去！

lines.en: : Helping you round up your memories sounds kinda fun, actually. It's like we're characters inside of a manga now or something.
lines.zh: : 帮你找回记忆听起来其实还挺好玩的。感觉我们现在就像漫画里的角色一样。

lines.en: : Yeah...or something.
lines.zh: : 是啊……就像一样。

lines.en: scene timetogrow12
: I wonder how it'll end. Normally, all of the stuff where the main character loses his memories ends up being kinda depressing by the last volume.
lines.zh: : 我在想结局会怎样呢。一般来说，主角失忆那种故事，到最后一卷都会挺压抑的。

lines.en: : I think there are more pressing matters at hand than figuring out how things are going to {i}end{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得眼下还有比猜{i}结局{/i}更紧要的事。

lines.en: scene timetogrow11
: Right, right. We've gotta get you back home since you can't remember where you live without me.
lines.zh: : 对对。得赶紧把你送回家，毕竟没有我你连自己住哪儿都记不住。

lines.en: : You know, Sensei, if you want to spend more time with me, all you have to do is ask. You don't have to fake amnesia just for my attention.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Sensei，如果你想多跟我待一会儿，直接说就好了。你不用为了引起我的注意而假装失忆。

lines.en: : Well, please forgive me if I continue to {i}fake{/i} it for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就请原谅我还要再{i}假装{/i}一阵子吧。

lines.en: Because at this point, I still have no idea what I'm supposed to do...
lines.zh: 因为到了这个地步，我依旧不知道自己该做什么……

lines.en: scene black
Ami spins around and I instinctively leave my desk to follow her, like it's something I've done time and time before.
lines.zh: Ami 转过身，我本能地离开座位跟上去，就像这件事我已经做过无数次一样。

lines.en: It's not, though.
lines.zh: 可并没有。

lines.en: This isn't my life.
lines.zh: 这不是我的人生。

lines.en: It can't be.
lines.zh: 不可能是。

lines.en: Because no one would ever look at me the way she does if this is where I'm meant to be.
lines.zh: 因为如果我注定该待在这里，绝不会有人用她那种眼神看我。

lines.en: Without even knowing myself yet, I understand that much.
lines.zh: 尽管我还不了解自己，但这一点我明白。

lines.en: For as she pulls me through the halls of the school by my wrist, my mind ventures forth to forbidden territories-
lines.zh: 她拉着我的手腕穿过学校的走廊，而我的心思已经溜向了禁忌的领域——

lines.en: And it encircles itself in possibilities and fantasies I will not yet reveal to you.
lines.zh: 它把自己缠绕在那些我还不能向你透露的可能与幻想之中。

lines.en: If I did, I can't imagine you'd stay to observe me much longer.
lines.zh: 要是我说了，我想你也不会留下来继续观察我了。

lines.en: But I suppose I don't even know who {i}you{/i} are...or who I'm even aiming these thoughts at right now.
lines.zh: 可我大概连{i}你{/i}是谁都不知道……也不知道我现在这些念头是冲着谁去的。

lines.en: Perhaps-
lines.zh: 也许——

lines.en: Well...perhaps they don't need to be aimed anywhere at all.
lines.zh: 嗯……也许它们根本不需要冲着任何地方。

lines.en: And perhaps I'm content with just imagining someone is there as it makes daydreaming all the less lonely.
lines.zh: 也许只要有个人在那里可以想象，就已经让我满足了，因为这样一来，做白日梦也就没那么孤单了。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath1
: Uhh...Ami?
lines.zh: : 呃……Ami？

lines.en: : Yes, dearest uncle?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，亲爱的叔叔？

lines.en: : Would you mind...you know...reminding me what the name of the city we live in is?
lines.zh: : 你介不介意……你知道的……提醒一下我们住的城市叫什么名字？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath2
: Jeez, even that's gone?
lines.zh: : 天哪，连这个都忘了？

lines.en: : Just assume that {i}everything{/i} is already gone since it'll wind up saving the two of us a ton of time.
lines.zh: : 你就当{i}所有东西{/i}都已经忘了吧，这样能帮我们俩省下大把时间。

lines.en: : Not {i}everything{/i} is gone, Sensei. I'm sure your love for me would remain no matter what sort of crazy thing happened to your brain.
lines.zh: : 并不是{i}所有东西{/i}都忘了啊，Sensei。我相信不管你脑子出了什么奇怪的毛病，你对我的爱都还在。

lines.en: : But, you're right. It's already kinda late out and I should be spending less time questioning you and more time helping you get back to normal.
lines.zh: : 不过，你说得对。天已经有点晚了，我应该少花点时间盘问你，多花点时间帮你恢复正常。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath3
: So, allow me to {i}re-{/i}introduce you to Kumon-mi! A super normal town just outside of Tokyo.
lines.zh: : 那么，请允许我{i}重{/i}新向你介绍 Kumon-mi！东京郊外一座超级普通的小镇。

lines.en: : We’re not allowed to leave the city limits anymore because of the war, but-
lines.zh: : 因为打仗，我们已经不准离开市区了，不过——

lines.en: : Wait, war? What war?
lines.zh: : 等等，打仗？什么仗？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath2
: The same war we've been in for years now.
lines.zh: : 就是我们已经打了好几年的那场仗啊。

lines.en: : Like 99%% of the men were drafted into the space army and are off fighting aliens right now or something.
lines.zh: : 大概 99%% 的男人都被征召进了太空军，现在正在外头跟外星人打仗什么的。

lines.en: : Is this...some sort of joke? Or...
lines.zh: : 这是……在开玩笑吧？还是……

lines.en: : Joke? No. It's super real.
lines.zh: : 玩笑？不是。这可是千真万确的。

lines.en: : And you should be thankful you weren't one of the people who got drafted since you're a teacher and we need more people like you to make sure everyone in our class doesn't wind up like Miku.
lines.zh: : 你该庆幸自己没被征召，因为你是老师，我们需要更多像你这样的人，来保证我们班上没人变成 Miku 那样。

lines.en: I have no idea who that even is...
lines.zh: 我根本不知道那是谁……

lines.en: : Is the war really in space, though?...
lines.zh: : 不过仗真的打在太空里吗？……

lines.en: : Of course. It's an important aspect of the plot that is going to be used as comedic relief in the future, so don't try and focus too much on it or you'll wind up getting distracted from everything else.
lines.zh: : 当然。这是剧情里很重要的一环，以后会拿来当喜剧桥段，所以别太纠结这个，不然你会被其他事情分心。

lines.en: : Everything else meaning {i}what,{/i} exactly? Are there some other...weird rules about this place I need to be lectured on now?
lines.zh: : 其他事情是指{i}什么{/i}？这地方还有什么奇怪的规则，需要你现在给我上课的吗？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath4
: A few! But really, the hardest part of everything is that the girl-to-boy ratio is completely out of whack and I wouldn't be surprised if you go weeks or months without seeing other men sometimes!
lines.zh: : 有那么几条！但真正最难的是男女比例完全失衡，有时候你几周甚至几个月都见不到别的男人，我都不会觉得奇怪！

lines.en: : I see no problem with this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这没什么问题啊。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath5
: Well, you should. That's the part where you were supposed to say, “You're the only girl for me, Ami! I don't care about any of the other ones!”
lines.zh: : 你该有才对。这时候你本来该说的是「你是我唯一的女孩，Ami！我一点也不在乎别的女人！」

lines.en: : Aren't we related?
lines.zh: : 我们不是亲戚吗？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath6
: Enough about that, how 'bout we get back to some of those rules you were just talking about?
lines.zh: : 那个先不提，我们还是回到你刚才说的那些规则上吧？

lines.en: : Are we really going to ignore the blatant incestuous undertones you-
lines.zh: : 我们真的要无视你明摆着的乱伦暗示吗——

lines.en: : Rule number one is keep your hands off all of your students! But that should probably be a rule that goes without saying since...you know.
lines.zh: : 规则一，不许对你所有的学生动手！不过这条大概不说也该懂，因为……你懂的。

lines.en: : Is that, like...an Ami rule? Or is that an actual school rule?
lines.zh: : 这是……Ami 的规则？还是学校真的有这条规定？

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure it's a law. But it's also a school rule.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是法律。但也是校规。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath7
: Technically, the rule only applies to school grounds, though...since no one can really keep track of what you do elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 不过严格来说，这条规定只在校内适用……毕竟你在校外做什么，也没人管得着。

lines.en: : Right...and is there anything else I should be worried about?
lines.zh: : 这样啊……那还有什么我需要担心的吗？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath1
: Probably! So just ask me whatever comes to mind and I'll help you out the best I can!
lines.zh: : 大概有！所以想到什么就问我，我会尽力帮你！

Tell me about my students
lines.zh: 跟我说说我的学生们

lines.en: : Can you tell me a little bit about my class?
lines.zh: : 你能不能给我讲讲我班上学生的情况？

lines.en: : You mean {i}remind{/i} you a little about your class?
lines.zh: : 你是说让我帮你{i}回忆{/i}一下你班上的学生？

lines.en: : Yeah...that. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 对……那个。抱歉。

lines.en: : Don't apologize to {i}me,{/i} Sensei. I'm used to dealing with you when you're at your worst. This sort of thing doesn't bother me at all.
lines.zh: : 别跟{i}我{/i}道歉啦，Sensei。我早就习惯应付状态最差时候的你。这种事我一点都不在意。

lines.en: : You're the only male teacher at an all-girls school...and there are ten total students you’re in charge of- including me!
lines.zh: : 你是一所女校里唯一的男老师……而你要负责的学生总共十名——包括我！

lines.en: : Our school works a little different from the other high school in that we’re in your care for every class of the day.
lines.zh: : 我们学校跟另一所高中不太一样，一天里所有课都由你管。

lines.en: : Sometimes, a student or two might not show up to class. A couple of them have cutting problems.
lines.zh: : 有时候会有一两个学生不来上课。她们中有几个有旷课的问题。

lines.en: : I also think I heard something about more students joining later on in the year as well!
lines.zh: : 我还听说，今年晚些时候也会有新学生加入！

lines.en: : Sometimes, classes get a little crowded and people need to be moved around and stuff.
lines.zh: : 有时候班上会有点挤，还得把人调来调去什么的。

lines.en: : Oh, in addition to being our teacher, you’re also our guidance counselor!
lines.zh: : 哦，除了当我们的老师，你还是我们的心理咨询师！

lines.en: : Some of the girls have issues they have a hard time discussing, so getting them to open up is part of your job.
lines.zh: : 有些女孩子有难以启齿的烦恼，所以让她们敞开心扉也是你工作的一部分。

lines.en: : Since the semester has only just begun, some of them are still in the process of warming up to you.
lines.zh: : 因为学期才刚开始，她们中有些人还在慢慢跟你熟起来。

lines.en: : Oh! But then there are also some girls like Ayane and Maya who you've known for years since they come to our house to sleep over all the time.
lines.zh: : 哦！不过也有 Ayane 和 Maya 这样的女孩，她们总来我们家过夜，所以你已经认识她们好多年了。

lines.en: : If you have any more specific questions about them, it would probably be better to check that weird book thingy you always keep lying around in your room.
lines.zh: : 要是你想更具体地打听她们的事，大概去看一下你房里老是摊着的那本奇怪的本子会比较好。

lines.en: : Book thingy?
lines.zh: : 本子？

lines.en: : I'm not really sure what it is since you won't let me look inside, but I'm pretty sure it's like...info on all of the students or something.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定那是什么，因为你不让我看里面，但我觉得应该是……所有学生的资料之类的。

lines.en: : Probably school related stuff since I know you'd never hide anything from me. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 应该是学校相关的东西吧，毕竟我知道你绝不会对我隐瞒什么。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah. Sure.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。当然。

lines.en: : Great!
lines.zh: : 太好了！

lines.en: : So, any other questions?
lines.zh: : 那么，还有别的问题吗？

Where are your parents?
lines.zh: 你的父母呢？

lines.en: : What about your parents? Why aren't you staying with them instead of-
lines.zh: : 你父母呢？你为什么不跟他们住，而是——

lines.en: : Ask something else.
lines.zh: : 问点别的吧。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : {i}Ask something else.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}问点别的吧。{/i}

What should I do?
lines.zh: 我该做什么？

lines.en: : So...what should I do?
lines.zh: : 那么……我该做什么？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath2
: Hm? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你什么意思？

lines.en: : Like...apart from teaching and...counseling or all of the other stuff my job requires me to do.
lines.zh: : 比如……除了教书，还有……心理咨询，或者其他我工作里该干的事之外。

lines.en: : I guess what I'm asking is...what is a normal day like for me?
lines.zh: : 我想问的是……对我来说，普通的一天是什么样的？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath1
: Oh, okay! Gotcha.
lines.zh: : 哦，好！明白了。

lines.en: : I don't know. That's kind of a tough question.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这问题有点难。

lines.en: : There's tons to do in Kumon-mi. And I'm sure you'll find plenty of ways to keep yourself entertained when you're not working or hanging out with me.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 里有很多事可做。我相信你不工作、也不陪我的时候，一定能找到大把乐子。

lines.en: : You know, I kind of figured a girl your age would be a little more interested in spending time with her friends rather than her uncle.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我本来还以为你这个年纪的女孩会更想和朋友待在一起，而不是和自己的叔叔待在一起。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath8
: I...can do both!
lines.zh: : 我……两个都可以！

lines.en: : And I won't let you make me feel like a loser because I like being closer to someone with the same blood as me!
lines.zh: : 而且我不会让你因为我和跟自己流着一样血的人更亲近，就让我觉得自己是个失败者！

lines.en: : Having the same blood is just a pretty specific thing to look for in a companion is all.
lines.zh: : 流着一样的血，这作为挑选伴侣的条件还真是相当具体啊。

lines.en: : I just told you! I won't let you make me feel like a loser just because I like spending time with you!
lines.zh: : 我刚说过了！我不会让你因为我喜欢跟你待在一起，就让我觉得自己是个失败者！

lines.en: : And I won't try to do that anymore, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我也不会再试着这么做了。

lines.en: : Again, I'm just trying to figure out how to use what little free time I'll have and...no offense, but I'm sure not all of it will be spent on you.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我只是在想该怎么利用我那点少得可怜的空闲时间，而且……无意冒犯，但我敢肯定不会全都花在你身上。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath2
: You can't just say “No offense” right before saying something super offensive, Sensei. It doesn't work that way.
lines.zh: : 你不能紧跟着一句「无意冒犯」就说超级冒犯的话，Sensei。这套可不管用。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath1
: But I guess expecting you to speak normally is a little much to ask since everything else seems to be different about you today anyway!
lines.zh: : 不过，指望你正常说话大概是有点强人所难了，毕竟今天的你一切都和平时不一样！

lines.en: : So, is there anything else you want to know?
lines.zh: : 那么，还有什么你想知道的吗？

lines.zh: : 还有别的想知道的吗？

Let's just move on
lines.zh: 还是继续往下走吧

lines.en: jump nextstart2
label nextstart2:
: I think I know everything I need to. Let's just go home and I'll...figure the rest out from there.
lines.zh: : 我想我知道的够多了。我们回家吧，剩下的……我到时候再自己想办法。

lines.en: : Cool! In that case, I-
lines.zh: : 好呀！那么，我——

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath9
: Ah! Wait!
lines.zh: : 啊！等等！

lines.en: : What? What's wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？出什么事了？

lines.en: : What's {i}wrong-{/i} is that Maya has been sitting all by herself over there this entire time and we haven't even noticed her.
lines.zh: : 出什么{i}事{/i}了——Maya 一直一个人坐在那边，我们居然到现在都没注意到她。

lines.en: : Maya! We're coming to say hello whether you like it or not!
lines.zh: : Maya！不管你愿不愿意，我们都要过来打招呼了！

lines.en: scene black
Ami charges away from me and I am stricken with the harsh realization that I might not be getting home as early as I was anticipating...
lines.zh: Ami 从我身边冲了出去，而我痛苦地意识到，我大概没法像预想中那么早到家了……

lines.en: scene mayacg1
I stop caring about that the moment I see her friend, though.
lines.zh: 不过，在看到她那个朋友的一瞬间，我就不再在乎这件事了。

lines.en: If I'm remembering correctly, this is...
lines.zh: 如果我没记错的话，这位是……

lines.en: This...
lines.zh: 这位……

lines.en: : Hello! Earth to Maya! Ami and Sensei reporting in.
lines.zh: : 你好！地球呼叫 Maya！Ami 和 Sensei 前来报到。

lines.en: scene mayacg2
: Hm?
scene mayacg7
: Ah-
scene whygodwhy
scene mayacg7
When our eyes meet, everything floods back into me.
lines.zh: 当我们四目相对的那一刻，一切重新涌回了我的脑海。

lines.en: I’m back in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我回到了 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: Back where I first started.
lines.zh: 回到了我最初开始的地方。

lines.en: Everything feels different...but somehow, exactly the same.
lines.zh: 一切都感觉不一样了……却又莫名地完全一样。

lines.en: This might not be where I am {i}meant{/i} to be-
lines.zh: 这里也许不是我{i}该{/i}待的地方——

lines.en: But it's where I am. And it's where I will stay until I am forcibly removed.
lines.zh: 但这里就是我所在的地方。而我会留在这里，直到被强行赶走为止。

lines.en: There is no home for me anywhere else, so I will carve a hole inside of {i}this{/i} world and sleep inside of it, refusing to move out even if the world around me breaks.
lines.zh: 我在别处已经无家可归，所以我要在{i}这个{/i}世界里挖一个洞，睡在里面，哪怕周围的世界崩塌也绝不搬出去。

lines.en: Because now I know that world will reset.
lines.zh: 因为现在我知道了，这个世界会重置。

lines.en: And that nothing here is permanent.
lines.zh: 也知道这里没有什么是永恒的。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 但是……

lines.en: What I don’t know is {i}how.{/i}
lines.zh: 我不知道的是，是{i}怎么{/i}做到的。

lines.en: scene mayacg8
Fortunately, I think the answer to that question is sitting right in front of me as we speak-
lines.zh: 所幸，我觉得这个问题的答案此刻就坐在我面前——

lines.en: Smiling a beautiful, crooked smile as she pretends to hate me more than she actually does.
lines.zh: 她挂着那抹美丽又别扭的微笑，装出比实际更讨厌我的样子。

lines.en: : You’re welcome...
lines.zh: : 不用谢……

lines.en: scene mayacg9
: Hey! What are you doing over here? I thought you had stuff to do after[school] today.
lines.zh: : 嘿！你在这儿干什么呢？我记得你今天[school]放学后还有事吧。

lines.en: : My plans fell through and I was hungry, so...
lines.zh: : 我的计划泡汤了，而且我饿了，所以……

lines.en: : Really? Well, you can come over later if you want. Sensei has amnesia, so-
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那你要不待会儿来我们家吧。Sensei 失忆了，所以——

lines.en: : Actually...
lines.zh: : 其实……

lines.en: : I’m fine, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我没事，Ami。

lines.en: : I guess I just needed to wake up.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是需要醒一醒。

lines.en: scene mayacg10
: Huh? Already? But...just a couple minutes ago you were all like-
lines.zh: : 哈？这就好了？可……就在几分钟前你还一副——

lines.en: : I’m fine, really. Let’s just treat today like any other day.
lines.zh: : 我真的没事。今天就像平常一样过吧。

lines.en: : Well...sure. If that's what you think is best, that's fine by me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。如果你觉得这样最好，我没意见。

lines.en: scene mayacg9
: Oh! I forgot to ask, but how did you do on your tests, Maya?
lines.zh: : 哦！我忘了问，你考试考得怎么样，Maya？

lines.en: : You were probably fine, right?
lines.zh: : 你应该还不错吧？

lines.en: : Thankfully, Makoto taught me all that slope-intercept stuff a couple weeks ago, so I’m pretty sure I passed by the skin of my teeth.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，Makoto 几周前把斜截式那套东西全教给我了，所以我估计是擦着边过的。

lines.en: : I did fine as well. Not great, not horrible.
lines.zh: : 我也还行。不算好，也不算糟。

lines.en: So...we’re {i}past{/i} the standardized tests now?
lines.zh: 那么……我们已经{i}过了{/i}统考那一段了？

lines.en: Weren't they just getting started the last time I woke up here?
lines.zh: 我上一次在这里醒来的时候，考试不是才刚开始吗？

lines.en: : Hey, random question, but...how far into the[school] year are we?
lines.zh: : 随便问一句，不过……[school]这一年已经过去多久了？

lines.en: scene mayacg10
: Huh? You don’t know? Isn’t that, like...your job?
lines.zh: : 哈？你不知道？那不是……你的工作吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but I forgot my phone at home and I’m not sure what today’s date is.
lines.zh: : 是，但我把手机忘在家里了，也不知道今天几号。

lines.en: scene mayacg11
: Hmm...I guess, only a few months? We’ve still got more than half of the year to go, I think.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概，才过了几个月吧？我觉得这一年还剩一大半呢。

lines.en: scene mayacg12
: You should probably start keeping track of stuff like that, Sensei! You’re already forgetful enough!
lines.zh: : 你该开始记一记这种事了，Sensei！你已经够健忘的了！

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll do my best...
lines.zh: : 是啊。我会尽力的……

lines.en: scene black
The rest of the day went on as if nothing ever changed.
lines.zh: 这一天剩下的时间，就像什么都没变过一样过去了。

lines.en: But somewhere-
lines.zh: 但在某个地方——

lines.en: In the back of my mind-
lines.zh: 在我脑海的深处——

lines.en: I remember a rooftop.
lines.zh: 我记得一个天台。

lines.en: I remember a sky.
lines.zh: 我记得一片天空。

lines.en: And I remember the scent of watermelon shampoo as a small girl wrapped her arms around me and changed my life forever.
lines.zh: 我还记得西瓜洗发水的香气，一个小小的女孩搂住了我，从此改变了我的一生。
